# Installing Gkeyll and postgkyl {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note}
**In preparation.** These instructions are being written and tested on a fresh
build before publication.
:::

This chapter will cover:

- **Prerequisites:** a C compiler and build tools on macOS and Linux.
- **Gkeyll:** cloning [gkeyllorg/gkeyll](https://github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll),
  building its dependencies, and building only the `core` and `moments` layers
  needed for these lectures.
- **postgkyl:** installing [postgkyl](https://github.com/gkeyllorg/postgkyl)
  from source into a Python environment, together with
  [marimo](https://marimo.io) for the lecture notebooks.
- **Checking the installation:** running a short test problem and loading its
  output with postgkyl.
